name: Car three: Danny's car across Mickey's rank
when: the giver's routine puts them where Frank is, and the job's state holds (the story director's card)

steps.verb: drive Danny's car off the rank (the keys are in it)

keys.how: to the quay's edge, front wheels over the water

steps.words: It's on my rank, so it's on my board. Car three. Two pound forty to the quay. Sheila, put it in the book.
lines: It's on my rank, so it's on my board. Car three. Two pound forty to the quay. Sheila, put it in the book.

steps.verb: hang the keys on Mickey's board and chalk CAR 3

pay.note: two pound forty to the quay; Sheila asks whether Mr Cammack wants a receipt

returns: Ada and Shaun saw it; by noon Brenda has it whole (STORY-FRAME 7 worked example 1)
